# Image to Prompt

> Image to Prompt is a Chrome extension that turns any picture on the web into a ready-to-use AI prompt. Right-click an image, choose "Get AI prompt", and a side panel shows the words that recreate it. Copy the prompt and paste it into any image generator (ChatGPT Images, Gemini, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, Ideogram and others). No sign-up, no API key, no upload form.

Key facts:
- Type: browser extension for Google Chrome and other Chromium browsers (Manifest V3).
- Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/objmjkdopmkfmhdnblknhgklkpcpbahg
- Access: no account or API key required.
- Input: any image you can right-click on a web page (photo, illustration, screenshot, AI-generated art).
- Output: a natural-language prompt of roughly 100–180 words describing subject, background, camera, light, palette, textures, style and mood.
- Actions in the panel: Copy prompt, Regenerate.
- Privacy: the image is sent securely to the extension's own service, processed transiently and forwarded to an AI provider; images are not stored. Only an anonymous identifier is used. Details on the privacy page.

## How it works

1. Right-click any image on any website.
2. Choose "Get AI prompt" in the context menu.
3. The Chrome side panel opens with the image thumbnail and the generated prompt.
4. Click "Copy prompt" and paste it into your image generator, or "Regenerate" for another version.

- [Welcome / first steps](https://imagetoprompt.online/welcome/): how to pin the extension to the toolbar and open the panel after installing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://imagetoprompt.online/privacy/): what data is processed, how it is used, stored and shared; analytics disclosure.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://imagetoprompt.online/guides/): practical guides to AI images and prompts.
- [AI Christmas photo generator](https://imagetoprompt.online/guides/ai-christmas-photo/): prompts and a prompt builder for turning your own photo into a Christmas photo or card in ChatGPT or Gemini (family card, photo with Santa, matching pajamas, snowy outdoors, pet in a Santa hat).
- [AI pet portrait generator](https://imagetoprompt.online/guides/ai-pet-portrait/): prompts and a prompt builder for turning a photo of a dog or cat into a portrait in ChatGPT or Gemini (Renaissance noble, classic oil painting, watercolor, pencil sketch, color studio photo, Christmas portrait).
- [How to change the background of a photo with AI](https://imagetoprompt.online/guides/change-photo-background/): prompts and a prompt builder for replacing a photo background in ChatGPT or Gemini (light studio, pure white for products, office, city street, beach at sunset, forest), with tips for natural light, shadows and hair edges.

## Common questions

- What is an image to prompt tool? A tool that reverse-engineers a picture into a text prompt you can reuse in AI image generators.
- Does it work with any generator? Yes. The prompt is plain descriptive text, so it fits ChatGPT Images, Gemini, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, Ideogram and others.
- Do I need an account or an API key? No. Install from the Chrome Web Store and use it right away.
- Which browsers are supported? Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers that support Chrome extensions and the side panel (for example Edge, Brave, Opera).
